items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: When he didn't play 'Rhapsody in Blue' we had Eddie Beal. Eddie Beal was on the piano. He was our original piano.

ctx.x: Is this where Teddy would come in?
No, he didn't play at the tea dances. When he didn't play 'Rhapsody in Blue' we had Eddie Beal.
